title: Axolotl Aquarium
description: A realistic planted aquarium with a pet axolotl, fish, shrimp and snails. Feed and pet your axolotl, then aquascape the tank with plants, stone, driftwood and sculpted sand.
controls: Drag to look around; scroll or pinch to zoom. Tap the axolotl to pet it, tap the sand to call it over. Use Feed, Decorate, Animals and Tank at the bottom; in Decorate, drag items to move them. H hides the interface.
